$comment: Azure Static Web Apps configuration (ADR-045, ADR-046). The importmap-hash placeholder in script-src is replaced at publish time by eng/deploy/publish-client.sh with the hash of the inline import map that the .NET build writes into index.html. The routes switch off the sign-in providers Static Web Apps enables on every site (GitHub, Microsoft Entra ID); the app has no accounts there. Routes must not set headers: every header comes from globalHeaders (rule tests, ADR-045).

globalHeaders.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' '{importmap-hash}'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; media-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
